title: Jabba the Hutt
subtitle: Crime Boss
text: Action [1 resource, Exhaust, return a friendly Underworld unit to its owner's hand]: Create a Credit token.
deployBox: Action: Play an Underworld unit from your hand. If you defeated a Credit while paying its cost, that unit gains Ambush for this phase.
epicAction: Epic Action: If you control 6 or more resources, deploy this leader.
rules:
Abilities that let you play a card require you to pay that card’s cost unless specified otherwise.
Abilities that return a card to hand must choose a card in play unless otherwise specified.
Jabba's action ability cannot be used as an action if you can't play a unit, as it would not change the game state.
